name: glass-nav-bar
props: Centred bar title (and the large title when largeTitle is on).
Big title under the bar that scrolls away while the small centred title fades in. Needs scrollY.
Your scroll view's offset (useGlassNavScroll). The glass fades in over ~40pt as content passes under the bar; without it the bar is solid glass.
Shows a round glass back button with a chevron.
Text beside the chevron (the button becomes a pill) and its accessibility label; "Back" otherwise.
Round glass buttons on the right, grouped so they merge on iOS 26.
Force light or dark glass and ink, e.g. over a photo.
Space above the bar for the status bar — pass your safe-area top inset.
Style for the bar container, which pins to the top of its parent.
Native-driver Animated.event for an Animated.ScrollView / FlatList (scrollEventThrottle 16).
Bar row height, and the full height the bar covers — use it as your content's paddingTop.
